description: JS fixes and enhancements: chat.js bug fixes (isSending guard, loadSessions throttle, suggestion card session creation, textarea content preservation on error, marked.js for AI markdown, scrollToBottom smart scroll, single retry button), sidebar.js search filtering and mobile drawer, documents.js drag-drop already working but needs upload zone class update. This feature depends on FEAT-002 for the new HTML IDs (msg-input instead of message-input, messages-list instead of chat-messages, welcome-screen instead of welcome-message, suggestion-card instead of suggestion-chip, data-prompt instead of data-question).
steps: Rewrite static/js/chat.js completely. Preserve all existing API contracts (API.get, API.post, loadSessions, openSession, createNewSession, appendMessage, handleSend, showToast). New additions and fixes: (1) Add isSending flag at module level: let isSending = false. In handleSend(), guard with: if (isSending) return; isSending = true; at start, isSending = false in finally block — this prevents double-sends and double error messages. (2) Change all getElementById references to match new HTML IDs from FEAT-002: 'message-input' → 'msg-input', 'chat-messages' → 'messages-list', 'welcome-message' → 'welcome-screen', 'messages-area' → 'messages-area' (unchanged). (3) Suggestion cards: change selector from '.suggestion-chip[data-question]' to '.suggestion-card[data-prompt]'. Change chip.dataset.question to chip.dataset.prompt. Auto-create session if currentSessionId is null then send prompt. (4) appendMessage(): use marked.parse(content) for AI messages: bubble.innerHTML = marked.parse(content) instead of bubble.textContent = content. For user messages keep textContent for XSS safety. (5) scrollToBottom(): implement smart auto-scroll — only scroll if user is near the bottom (within 100px). Track let autoScroll = true; on messages-area scroll event: autoScroll = (area.scrollHeight - area.scrollTop - area.clientHeight) < 100. In scrollToBottom: if (autoScroll) area.scrollTop = area.scrollHeight. (6) loadSessions() throttle: use a simple timestamp throttle — let lastSessionLoad = 0; function shouldLoadSessions() { const now = Date.now(); if (now - lastSessionLoad < 2000) return false; lastSessionLoad = now; return true; } Call loadSessions() after successful send only if shouldLoadSessions(). (7) Preserve textarea content on error: save const savedContent = textarea.value before clearing it. In the catch block: if error occurs, restore textarea.value = savedContent. (8) Single retry button on failed message: in catch block, instead of only showToast, also append a failed message row with a 'Retry' button. The row has class 'message-row message-row--error'. The retry button calls handleSend() after re-filling textarea. (9) After successful response, call loadSessions() unconditionally (throttled). (10) renderSessionList(): add group labels Today/This Week/Older by comparing s.updated_at date. Use a helper groupByDate(sessions) that returns { today: [], thisWeek: [], older: [] }. Render each non-empty group with a .session-group-label div then the items. (11) Keep existing keyboard handling, char-count logic, and formatDate/escapeHtml helpers. (12) handleSend: hide welcome-screen on first message (document.getElementById('welcome-screen')?.style.display = 'none').

Update static/js/sidebar.js. (1) Add session search: document.getElementById('session-search')?.addEventListener('input', (e) => { const q = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase(); document.querySelectorAll('.session-item').forEach(item => { const title = item.querySelector('.session-item-title')?.textContent.toLowerCase() || ''; item.style.display = (!q || title.includes(q)) ? '' : 'none'; }); const groups = document.querySelectorAll('.session-group-label'); groups.forEach(g => { const nextSibling = g.nextElementSibling; let hasVisible = false; let el = g.nextElementSibling; while (el && !el.classList.contains('session-group-label')) { if (el.style.display !== 'none') hasVisible = true; el = el.nextElementSibling; } g.style.display = hasVisible ? '' : 'none'; }); }). (2) Mobile drawer: update toggle handler — if window.innerWidth <= 768, toggle sidebar.classList 'mobile-open' and body.classList 'sidebar-open'; else toggle sidebar.classList 'collapsed' and body.classList 'sidebar-collapsed'. Add click handler: document.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (window.innerWidth <= 768 && sidebar.classList.contains('mobile-open') && !sidebar.contains(e.target) && e.target.id !== 'sidebar-toggle') { sidebar.classList.remove('mobile-open'); document.body.classList.remove('sidebar-open'); } }). (3) Keep existing logout handler and active state detection.

Verify static/js/documents.js is compatible with the new upload zone. The existing documents.js already handles dragover/dragleave/drop events on #upload-zone and calls uploadFile(). The new documents.html keeps the same id='upload-zone' and id='file-input'. No functional changes needed. Only verify: (a) The .dragover class is toggled on the upload-zone element — CSS in FEAT-003 already adds .upload-zone.dragover styles. (b) The progress bar uses id='upload-progress', id='progress-bar', id='progress-text' — these are preserved in documents.html. If anything is mismatched, fix the ID references.

Update the chat.js DOMContentLoaded listener to wire up the new IDs: replace 'message-input' with 'msg-input' everywhere (textarea querySelector). Replace 'chat-messages' with 'messages-list' in appendMessage and openSession. Replace 'welcome-message' with 'welcome-screen'. Replace 'suggestion-chip' selector with '.suggestion-card[data-prompt]' and dataset.question with dataset.prompt. Ensure typing indicator show/hide uses 'typing-indicator' ID (unchanged). Ensure send button ID is 'send-btn' (unchanged).

Add marked.js configuration at the top of chat.js DOMContentLoaded, after the DOM is ready: if (window.marked) { marked.setOptions({ breaks: true, gfm: true }); } — this enables GitHub-flavored markdown and line breaks.
acceptance_criteria: Rapid double-click on send button only sends one message (isSending guard works)
AI responses render with markdown formatting (bold, code blocks, lists) instead of raw text
Clicking a suggestion card on the welcome screen creates a session and sends the prompt
On send error, textarea content is restored (not cleared)
Session list shows Today/This Week/Older group labels
Sidebar search input filters the session list in real-time
verification: python -m pytest tests/ -v — all tests pass
Open http://localhost:8080/chat, click a suggestion card — verify session is created and AI responds
Send a message that returns markdown (ask 'give me a list') — verify the AI bubble renders formatted HTML
Double-click send rapidly — verify only one message sent
Disconnect network, try to send — verify textarea content preserved after error
Type in sidebar search box — verify session list filters instantly
